headlines.title: PepsiCo vs. Starbucks: Which Consumer Goods Stock Is a Better Buy for 2027?
headlines.summary: Starbucks trades at nearly twice PepsiCo's forward earnings multiple, but its free cash flow and loyalty-driven model raise a sharper question about which premium is justified.

headlines.title: Starbucks (SBUX) Stock Could Be 33% Overvalued Despite Turnaround Bonus Push
headlines.summary: Starbucks has delivered a solid 23.8% gain over the past year, which puts a fresh spotlight on a simple question for anyone looking at the shares today. Is the current price around US$103 being supported by the cash the business is expected to generate over time, or has sentiment moved ahead of those underlying flows? The 23.8% 1 year return raises the stakes for buyers because more of the expected future cash generation may already be reflected in the quote.

headlines.title: How Many Shares of McDonald’s, Starbucks or Darden Pay $1,000 a Month in Dividends?
headlines.summary: Key TakeawaysAt today’s prices, $1,000 a month in dividends takes about $424,900 of McDonald’s stock, about $418,100 of Darden Restaurants or about $491,100 of Starbucks. McDonald’s paid out 70% of its free cash flow as dividends over the last 12 months, and analysts expect 69% for fiscal 2026.

description: Starbucks Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, operates as a roaster, marketer, and retailer of coffee internationally. The company operates through three segments: North America, International, and Channel Development. Its stores offer coffee, tea, and other beverages, roasted whole beans and ground coffees, complementary food, packaged coffees, single-serve products, and ready-to-drink beverages; and various food products, such as pastries, breakfast sandwiches, and lunch items. The company also licenses its trademarks through licensed stores, and grocery and foodservice accounts. The company offers its products under the Starbucks Coffee, Teavana, Ethos, and Starbucks Reserve brands. Starbucks Corporation was founded in 1971 and is based in Seattle, Washington.
